encounter.title: Prologue 4 — Two Enemies / Priority (5x5 Candidate A, seed 119)
encounter.notes: LD-005 Prologue 5x5 Candidate A. Board: square5 (5x5), seed 119, 7 arrows (N2 E2 S1 W2). Urgent Grunt E (2 HP, IN 3, dmg 2) and Slow Grunt N (2 HP, IN 5, dmg 2). Clean sequence: #0(E) -> #2(N) -> #1(E) -> #3(N) kills urgent E on turn 3 before strike, then slow N on turn 4. Priority mistake: killing slow N first allows Grunt E to strike for 2 damage.
